note: How a freshly reset phone becomes a Belay phone, step by step: each step's command, how its result is checked, what it says when that fails, and its waits and retries. provision.sh runs it with the interpreter in lib.sh, and the setup kit (setup-kit/) with its own, on the same fixtures (plan-tests/). The format is in docs/setup-kit.md. Steps that only apply to a debug (test-only) build test {test_only}.

steps.page: Connect Belay to your family's server
steps.note: After the restart, so the phone is unlocked again (Belay's service only runs after that) and back online. EnrollReceiver, which only senders holding WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS (the adb shell) can reach, enrolls and answers with a short outcome, never the device token (platform notes E1).

retry.first: The server can't be reached yet (the phone may still be connecting); trying again for a minute...
retry.note: Right after the restart the phone may not be online yet. The code is only used once the server answers, so trying again while it can't be reached is safe.
